name: report_id
description: UUID per row; used as insertId for best-effort dedup on retries

name: qhash
description: query_info.query_hashes.normalized_literals for a query finding; the 'project.dataset.table' string for a storage/write finding

name: cost_before_bytes
description: bytes billed (query) or logical/input bytes (storage/write) at the time of this report

name: cost_before_slot_ms
description: total slot-ms over the window; null for storage/write findings

name: proposal
description: JSON-encoded structured proposal (bq_propose output), when the model made one; null otherwise

name: verdict
description: accept | reject (from verify_rewrite/verdict) for a query proposal; the storage/write finding's own kind (no_expiration/unread/large_unpartitioned/unbatched/errors) otherwise

name: bytes_after
description: bytes a verified rewrite's dry run reported; null when there is no accepted proposal
